decisions: Removed unnecessary pauses after short subjects and corrected the folder sentence subject.
Retained 正本 as the authoritative-document term, ゲート as a physical game object, and 解像度 as the display term.
Retained parallel requirements and unknowns as lists because each item has an independent verification purpose.
Retained the fall-penalty contrast because elapsed recovery time must be added to the extra three seconds.
RESULTS introduces artifact-checks.json and completion wording after the file/link check actually ran; the meaning-risk candidates match this evidence.
The request wording 検討して is not a claim of implementation. All deliverables remain explicitly unimplemented design proposals.
The reduced-motion wording in SPEC is broad; ART_DIRECTION gives the initial concrete setting: 68-degree fixed FOV, no camera roll, no shake or speed lines.
